schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Group all non-major Rust dependency bumps into one PR. Individually they are noise; together they are one CI run and one review.
sqlx dictates the MSRV. A major bump can move the toolchain floor and change the SqlSafeStr API, so it is never grouped and never automerged.
The Rust toolchain and the Alpine build base both affect the static musl build validated in Phase 0. Bump them deliberately, together, and re-check the image builds.
GitHub Actions bumps are low-risk and high-volume; group and automerge patch/minor once CI is green.
Pin GitHub Actions to commit SHAs. A mutable tag on a third-party action is arbitrary code execution in a workflow that holds registry credentials.
Never silently jump a major version of anything in the delivery path.
